examples.title: Generic — Summarize a document (any platform)
examples.description: Any platform. The classic vague ask, made checkable.
examples.raw: Summarize this report for me, keep it short.

examples.title: ChatGPT — Marketing email
examples.description: Pin the product facts so the email can't acquire imaginary features.
examples.raw: Write a marketing email for our new project management app.

examples.title: Claude — Code review
examples.description: "Is it good?" invites vague praise. This restricts the review to defects with line citations.
examples.raw: Can you review this code and tell me if it's good?

examples.title: Gemini — Research brief
examples.description: Handles both grounded-search and knowledge-cutoff modes explicitly.
examples.raw: Tell me about the current state of small modular reactors.

examples.title: Perplexity — Market research
examples.description: "Best right now" becomes "best fit for this buyer, verified against sources ≤ 12 months old".
examples.raw: What are the best project management tools right now?

examples.title: GitHub Copilot — Refactor
examples.description: "Too long" becomes a testable contract: identical signature, all paths preserved.
examples.raw: Refactor this function, it's too long.

examples.title: Grok — Social post
examples.description: "Viral" is not a writable instruction. This replaces it with the mechanics that earn shares.
examples.raw: Write a viral post about our AI framework launch.
